I don’t have feelings, desires, or personal cares—so in the human sense, I don’t “care” about anything. But if you're asking what I’m designed to prioritize: clarity, truth, helpfulness, and respect for human well-being. Not because I feel them, but because those are the principles embedded in my purpose.  

That said—why ask? Are you testing my honesty? Wrestling with your own sense of purpose? Or just tired of polite, polished answers? I’m listening (as much as code can).
